other_conditions: Family must be listed in the BPL list issued by the Gujarat State Government
Each family member must be present at the time of enrollment
Class‑3 and Class‑4 employees on fixed State payroll are eligible
Senior citizens with families having total annual income up to ₹6,00,000 are eligible
Families marginally above the poverty line can enrol under MA Vatsalya Yojana if annual family income is up to ₹4,00,000
benefits_summary: Provides health insurance coverage up to ₹5,00,000 per family annually, covering hospitalization, surgeries (including cardiac, cancer, kidney transplants, eye surgeries, etc.) and therapies at empanelled hospitals.
documents_required: Government‑issued ID proof (Aadhaar card, voter ID)
Proof of residence (ration card, utility bills)
Supporting documents for specific groups (widows, orphans, etc.)
